column1: Statistical analysis of positive well counts in callus co-cultivation and TSB-only groups over time.

Note:
Data Presentation: Data are presented as Mean and Standard Deviation (SD) in separate columns (n=9 biological replicates). 
Statistical Analysis: Differences between the Co_cultivation (callus-cocultivation) and TSB-only groups at each time point were assessed using a paired Student’s t-test. 
Significance: Statistical significance levels are denoted as: ns, not significant (P > 0.05); *, P < 0.05; **, P < 0.01; ***, P < 0.001.
